description: This file is a PHP source script for editing wireless network configurations in a web-based interface. It contains PHP logic for retrieving and setting Wi-Fi parameters, embedded JavaScript for UI interactions, and HTML for the webpage layout, all focused on configuring Wi-Fi network settings such as SSID, security mode, channels, and passwords.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple wireless configuration parameters from external data source based on provided root and parameter mappings.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays the security modes selection dialog with options for WPA/WPA2 encryption settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Gathers the form data and sends an AJAX request to save the wireless network configuration.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to reset or restore default Wi-Fi settings based on provided info.

methods.name: init_form
methods.description: Initializes the web form with current wireless settings and configures UI elements like dropdowns and checkboxes.
